description: List UK tax/payroll deadlines. Fixed-date deadlines get the next due date on or after from_date (default today, Europe/London) and are filtered to to_date; deadlines that depend on your own period (e.g. VAT, Corporation Tax, Companies House) follow with next_due null and a plain-English recurrence_rule. Paid: $0.005 USD per call via x402, or use an API key (see /pricing).

from_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today in Europe/London

name: list_deadlines
